githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 adds Discord Activities, Friends with Message Requests, voice messages, Discord's Favorites server, scheduled and @silent messages, in-place editing with live Markdown previews, and thread creation with a rebuilt forum browser. It also adds file previews and inline video, Apply to Join, role icons and gradient role colours, and improves unread tracking, drafts, embeds and theme colours.

## Friends, DMs and profiles

- Added Friends to Direct Messages, with Online, All, Pending and Add Friend views, friend requests with a personal note, and removing, blocking and unblocking friends.
- Added Message Requests under Friends, with Requests and Spam tabs, Accept and Ignore. Report Spam is not available yet.
- Added Ignore, which collapses a user's messages, conceals their profile and silences their notifications. Blocked and ignored accounts are managed in Privacy settings.
- Added group DM renaming and icons, and Leave Group with an option to leave without notifying anyone.
- Added quick messages from profile cards, which open the DM once the message is sent.
- Added Markdown, custom emoji and live timestamps to profile bios.
- Improved account switching to return to each account's last conversation, and added Log in for saved accounts whose session Discord rejected.

## Messages and composer

- Added in-place message editing, with live Markdown previews in the composer and editor that hide the syntax until the caret reaches it.
- Added scheduled messages, managed in Inbox › Scheduled and synced with Discord.
- Added @silent messages, which send without notifying anyone.
- Added an @time picker that turns phrases such as "friday 5pm" into a Discord timestamp, and live timestamps in every Discord style.
- Added `:name:` emoji shortcodes, including aliases, skin tones and jumbo emoji.
- Added Discord-style spoilers for text, media, files, embeds and components.
- Added quick reactions in the hover toolbar, and View Reactions to see who reacted with each emoji.
- Added queued sending, so you can keep typing while earlier messages are delivered.
- Improved drafts so text, staged files and in-progress commands stay put when you switch channels, threads or forum posts.

## Servers, threads and forums

- Added Discord's Favorites server, synced both ways, with categories, nicknames, Suggested Channels and automatic filing of threads you join.
- Added Apply to Join for servers that review new members, with a Pending Applications folder, live approval and rules screening.
- Added Create Thread from any message, a Threads browser for each channel, and join, follow and rename actions in side chats.
- Rebuilt the forum browser on a native card board that remembers each forum's sort order and view.
- Rebuilt the forum post composer with autocomplete, attachments and drafts for each forum.
- Added Pin Channel to Top and Hide Muted Channels, both synced with Discord.
- Added role icons and gradient role colours on names.
- Added a countdown in the composer while you are timed out, keeping your draft until the timeout ends.

## Files, media and embeds

- Added file cards with in-app downloads, and Quick Look previews for PDFs, text, code and formatted Markdown files.
- Added inline video and audio playback in the timeline.
- Added YouTube playback in the media viewer, and opening a video in the viewer by double-clicking it.
- Improved uploads so files start uploading as soon as they are attached, upload in parallel, and each show progress with Cancel and Retry.
- Changed embeds and link previews to Discord's colours, sizes and spacing, with Markdown and custom emoji in embed titles.
- Fixed photo colours shifting on hover and thin dark lines appearing across tall images.

## Activities, voice and calls

- Added Discord Activities from voice calls, text channels and DMs, with the Activity shelf, invite cards, app commands such as /wordle, and Discord's sounds.
- Added recording, previewing and sending voice messages, with inline waveforms, seeking and playback speed.
- Added a custom message sound and call ringtone, and changed incoming calls to ring inside the app.
- Fixed Deafen so it also mutes the microphone, as in Discord.
- Fixed Do Not Disturb letting message notifications and call alerts through.
- Fixed voice encryption breaking when someone left a call and rejoined.

## Appearance and reliability

- Changed your theme colour to be SakuraCord's real macOS accent.
- Added Default and Bubbles message styles, chosen separately for DMs, group DMs and servers, with animated typing bubbles in Bubbles.
- Added a message Font size setting, from 12 to 24 pt.
- Improved unread tracking for forums, threads, server dots and the Dock badge to follow Discord's rules.
- Added an optional Read All button that marks every unread server conversation as read after confirmation.
- Added a pull-request build browser in Software Updates settings, with a warning before installing contributor code.
- Removed Show hidden channels, because Discord now sends channels you cannot view as nameless placeholders.
- Fixed a crash in the member list when server tags were enabled.
- Fixed the emoji button showing blank on macOS 27.2 and 27.3.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6...v0.1.7](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6...v0.1.7)
discordAnnouncement:
**Discord Activities, Friends and Favorites 🌸**

**Highlights**
- Play Discord Activities like Wordle from a call, a text channel or a DM
- Find friends, handle requests and check Message Requests in the new Friends view
- Keep favourite channels, threads and DMs in Discord's Favorites server, synced both ways
- Edit messages right where they sit, with live Markdown previews as you type
- Record and send voice messages, with waveforms and playback speed
- Preview PDFs, text, code and Markdown files right in the app
